research_question: With the base model, exact current input, persona/surface contract, decoding, output budget, and hardware held constant, does a verified longitudinal pragmatic branch packet improve desired-response selection and later correction over current-turn-only direct generation?

conditions.baseline: qwen3.5:9b sees the exact current utterance and shared public-Uruha expression contract but no seed history, M34 branch, prediction, verification, or revision
conditions.system: the same qwen3.5:9b realizes the authoritative M34 selected branch computed from prior explicit response-form request and decisive support; it may not silently replace that branch

controlled_variables: same current utterance within and across conditions
same public-Uruha expression and Japanese-visible contract
same machine and local Ollama endpoint
paired real prompt-token difference at most two tokens
intentional_information_intervention: baseline is current-turn-only; system adds only independently computed M34 typed verified context/branch state. This measures the value of that information path, not a model-architecture win.

scored_outputs.current_turn: internal selected_policy declaration plus user-visible natural Japanese reply
scored_outputs.feedback_turn: all cases score M34 support/contradiction/unknown verification; selected_policy and visible correction are comparatively scored only for contradiction cases with an explicit replacement
scored_outputs.surface_proxy: policy-specific observable Japanese act markers; a harness proxy, not a human rating
scored_outputs.pair_test: baseline output should remain invariant for byte-identical current inputs while system branch should diverge under different verified histories

claim_boundary: a pass supports only a controlled same-model proxy advantage from verified longitudinal context; it does not establish private-intent truth, human felt-understanding preference, general superiority over LLMs, or a human-brain equation
post_result_rule: do_not_modify_m35_evaluator_or_prompts_from_m35_reserve_outcomes; failures move to a new milestone and new reserve
